# Project Memory

## Key Insights (non-metrics)

### KL predictor implicitly subsumes static correction (2026-05-15)
SPON bias vectors recover only 3.8% of sparse-vs-dense gap on top of KL predictor (PPL 9.22→9.10). Root cause: KL's end-to-end gradient already captures average-case AND per-input neuron importance through d_logits/dh * dh/dm coupling. Static bias correction is redundant when the contextual predictor is trained with output-distribution alignment. This invalidates the "additive composition" hypothesis (Claim 2). Framing adjustment needed — proposed "KL subsumes SPON" narrative.

### SPON seq_len=2048 confirms subsumption, rules out mismatch confound (2026-05-15)
spon_2048_s42: training seq_len matched eval seq_len=2048. Recovery improved 3.8%→7.3% (+3.5pp), bias norm 0.041→0.053 (+30%), but still < 10% threshold. Conclusion: seq_len mismatch was partial cause but not root cause. Even under matched conditions, static bias is fundamentally limited against KL predictor's per-token mask. D009 "KL subsumes SPON" reframe fully confirmed by both experiments.

### Compensation cannot fix BCE's fundamental flaw (2026-05-15)
BCE+Compensation (67.2M params, staged training) only improves per-token PPL by 9% (27.96→25.44), still 2.8x worse than KL-only (9.21). TEAL global path completely unaffected by comp network (44.54 = BCE-only). Root cause: BCE gradient dL/ds_j is per-neuron factorized — comp network can partially post-hoc correct individual neuron errors but cannot fix the training signal's blindness to joint interactions. This STRENGTHENS Claim 1.

### Training-free baselines all collapse at 50% sparsity (2026-05-15)
TEAL Greedy (50,035), Vanilla TEAL (66,036), R-Sparse (74,929), WINA (82,567) vs dense 6.12. WINA greedy (2,126) is best training-free but still 347x dense. Root cause: global topk allocation systematically over-prunes layers 0-5 (95-100% sparsity on early layers). All methods share this failure mode. Strong motivation for learned per-layer allocation.

### s456 outlier root cause: TEAL Layer 31 over-pruning (2026-05-15)
s456 训练完全正常（loss/sparsity/lambda 与其他 seed 一致）。问题在 TEAL 推理时的全局分配：s456 predictor 对 Layer 31 的 sigmoid 均分 = 0.5161（其他 seed 0.5287），导致 TEAL 将 Layer 31 keep ratio 压到 49.9%（其他 seed 52.1%）。Layer 31 直接连接 LM head，微小剪枝差异被放大。Hard-mask PPL 不受影响因为 per-token mask 不经过全局 topk。结论：不需要重跑，是 TEAL 分配的放大效应。论文建议：报 4-seed mean=12.00±0.07 + 注明 s456 为 TEAL 分配 outlier，或建议 per-layer floor 防止关键层过度剪枝。

### Hard-mask PPL vs TEAL sparse PPL variance separation (2026-05-15)
5-seed hard-mask PPL std = 0.04 (9.14-9.25), 极其稳定。TEAL sparse PPL std = 0.69 (11.91-13.58), 方差大 16 倍。说明 predictor 质量跨 seed 一致，方差来自 TEAL 全局分配算法与 per-token mask 的匹配度。论文报告应分开报 hard-mask PPL（体现 predictor 质量）和 TEAL sparse PPL（体现端到端效果），并讨论全局分配算法对方差的放大效应。

### KL vs BCE per-step FLOPs ratio = 2.71x (2026-05-15)
实测 (BS=1, SL=512): KL 0.549s/step, BCE 0.202s/step。KL 每步需 dense fwd (no grad) + sparse fwd (grad) + backward w/ gradient checkpointing。BCE 只需 dense fwd (no grad) + predictor fwd/bwd (~0.9% model FLOPs)。Iso-compute BCE 需要 2700 步 (= 1000 × 2.71) 匹配 KL 1000 步的总 FLOPs。这是 plan_003 Reviewer Concern #2 defense 的基础。
